The Router marked all structural checkpoints as 'is_present: false', which is accurate because the image depicts modern wraparound sunglasses, not a single convex lens on a stand. The Router was not too lenient; it rigorously applied the taxonomy even though the taxonomy itself appears to be misaligned with the common definition of the class label. alignment_reasoning: The image fails almost every checkpoint in the provided taxonomy because it depicts the wrong object type (eyewear vs. burning glass). While the `fine_grained_classifier` confirms the image is indeed 'sunglasses' (eyewear), the evaluation must adhere to the provided taxonomy which defines 'sunglass' as a magnifying tool. Therefore, alignment is critically low. A small fraction of points is given only because the object is optically related (lenses), but structurally it is a complete mismatch.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from significant text generation failures (gibberish on box/manual) and minor geometric grounding issues (floating loose lenses). The main sunglass frame is topologically sound (high mask confidence), preventing a catastrophic artifact score. However, the text artifacts are severe enough to drag the quality down significantly, resembling a mid-tier AI generation with clear tell-tale signs of synthesis.
